question: Should OpenClaw permanently own a durable AI-safety event taxonomy with `safetyDiagnostics`/`safetyEventTypes` as public plugin contracts, or should this capability remain limited to existing diagnostics seams and external plugins?
rationale: The branch changes the plugin SDK/manifest and shared-state product boundary, so implementation review cannot safely choose the permanent API, authorization model, and retention policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
options.body: Approve a documented event schema, plugin permission model, observer access rule, and retention/query boundary before the branch is narrowed and rebased.

options.title: Keep core generic
options.body: Decline the new plugin safety API and durable operator surface, leaving specialized safety instrumentation to external plugins using existing diagnostics seams.

options.title: Stage the work
options.body: Approve only an internal core event bridge first and defer public plugin APIs, durable history, and UI/CLI surfaces to later reviewed changes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a documented event schema, plugin permission model, observer access rule, and retention/query boundary before the branch is narrowed and rebased.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical request and the active implementation series, so they are the best available person to refine the proposal once a maintainer chooses the intended product boundary.
